prompts.pocket-letterpress:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a realistic, production-quality MOBILE-FIRST WEBSITE design for Luis Augusto's digital business card. One independent portrait screenshot; one concept only. Logical viewport dimensions exactly 390 x 844 CSS pixels, rendered at high resolution with the exact corresponding tall aspect ratio. This is WEBSITE CONTENT ONLY, no phone body, device bezel, rounded screen mask, browser chrome, notch, status bar, home indicator, or surrounding presentation canvas. Fill the entire image with the narrow mobile webpage. Do not scale down a desktop composition. Every measurement below is in logical CSS pixels.
The user likes tactile paper textures, soft colors, skeuomorphism and delightful physical card interactions, specifically the attached previous desktop concept, but says the website must be mobile-first. Recompose intelligently for a phone with generous 20px side margins. No horizontal overflow, no clipped content, no tiny type, and no side-by-side desktop hero. Body and utility text 14-16px, identity name 34-42px, visible tap controls at least 44px tall. Maximum 2 fonts, a characterful elegant serif and a clean sans. Plenty of purposeful breathing room, not huge empty areas. A single clear primary "Save my contact" action, within the initial viewport. Keep all essential contact information visible without flipping, pulling, swiping or hovering. Show a visible touch control for any optional physical interaction. No hover-only instructions. On supporting iPhones preserve the existing secondary Add to Apple Wallet action as a modest black badge below the primary button, not a rival huge CTA. Supporting GitHub, LinkedIn, Email links grouped in a compact legible horizontal text row. A small Writing link or relevant card is allowed. Do not invent article titles, metrics, availability, credentials, companies, or dates.
Exact copy where present: "Luis Augusto", "Product & Growth Engineering", "Sacramento, CA", "hello@luis.app", "Save my contact", "GitHub", "LinkedIn", "Email", "Add to Apple Wallet". Preserve the real user's face and appearance from the supplied portrait, no replacement person.
Input image 1: desktop concept being adapted, for mood/material inspiration, NOT a layout to shrink. Input image 2: real portrait to reuse faithfully. Input image 3: existing website for content grounding, NOT target layout. Crisp readable typography is essential. Keep paper texture delicate under text, believable fine fibers and pressed ink, lovely but subtle contact shadows and material depth. Avoid shiny plastic, harsh gradients, neon, heavy shadows, decoration covering text, excessive rotations and dashboard UI. One complete design, no annotations, no concept title printed as UI, no before/after comparison.Concept name: Pocket Letterpress. Reimagine the attached Pressed in Paper concept as an exquisitely crafted 390 x 844 mobile webpage. Soft warm ivory background with very fine paper grain, pale olive text, tiny ochre accents. Entire composition single-column. At top, tiny dark-olive LA monogram on left and compact "Sacramento, CA" on right. Main hero begins around y=85: a single upright ivory cotton-stock business card, 338px wide x 420px tall, centered with at most a 1-degree rotation, subtle embossed rim, thin amber paper edge and small realistic soft shadow. No desk props or plants. Inside the card, an 88px circular supplied portrait near the upper left balanced by a small understated debossed LA mark upper right. Mid-card beautiful large refined dark espresso serif "Luis" and "Augusto" on two lines, left-aligned with perfect optical spacing. The name is the focus. Under it, clean 15px "Product & Growth" and "Engineering" on two readable lines. Bottom left "hello@luis.app". A small brass-colored curved-arrow detail at lower right. Thick uncoated stock, delicate genuine-looking fibers, debossed dark ink, soft side lighting. The card is compact enough that all actions fit underneath.
Immediately under the card a visible quiet 44px-high "Turn card" text button with curved arrow. Then a wide olive "Save my contact" button, 54px high, within the page margins. Below it a modest recognizable black Add to Apple Wallet badge. Below badge clean 44px-high GitHub / LinkedIn / Email row, restrained line divider and tiny Writing link in lower footer if space. Touch-friendly and beautifully spaced. No extra copy or duplicated name outside the card, no decorative marketing headline. Palette only ivory, olive, muted brass, natural portrait colors. The result should be immediately usable at phone scale and feel like holding a beautiful little personal card.

Small LA monogram at top left and "Sacramento, CA" top right. ONE COMPACT UPRIGHT DECK only, total width no more than 340px including shadows, centered below header.
